parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description:
The end time to query for slow SQL executions.

The time must be in UTC format: YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description: The ID of the OceanBase cluster.

parameters.name: ReturnSqlText
parameters.description: Specifies whether to return the SQL text.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description:
The start time to query for slow SQL executions.

The time must be in UTC format: YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ.
